name: Summon Dominion
description: (Tag:summon)Temporarily summon a very high-ranked Angel or Holy Spirit from the Heavenly Realm, such as Light Spirit Lords, Dominions, 8 Winged Angels, Archangels (Hota), Valkyrie Chiefs, etc., limited to Epic familiar power or less. Bound to your will, it needs your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.
